company_description: Vallourec S.A., through its subsidiaries, provides tubular solutions for the oil and gas, industry, and new energies markets in North America, South America, France, the Middle East, Indonesia, and East Asia. It operates through Tubes and Mine & Forests segments. The company offers seamless tubes for refineries, petrochemical facilities, onshore liquefied natural gas (LNG) facilities, and floating LNG facilities, as well as for floating production, storage, and offloading units; VAM connections; rigid subsea line pipes, onshore rigid line pipes, and pipe coating solutions; and carbon steel and steel alloy tubes, hollow bars, and connections. It also provides assistance in lowering tubes, inspecting connections, and supervising assembly; inventory management; engineering; training; on-site services; preparation for drilling operations; and integrated solutions for the subsea pipelines comprising analysis, coating, insulation, bending, logistics, and project management with digital support solutions. description.long_fr: Vallourec est un producteur mondial de solutions tubulaires sans soudure de haute performance pour les marchés énergie (pétrole et gaz, géothermie, hydrogène) et industrie. Le groupe exploite des laminoirs et tubes à chaud, dont le site flagship de Youngstown (États-Unis). Chiffre d'affaires 2024 : ~3.8 Mds €.
description.long_en: Vallourec is a global producer of high-performance seamless tubular solutions for energy (oil and gas, geothermal, hydrogen) and industrial markets. The group operates rolling mills and hot tubes, including the Youngstown flagship plant (United States). 2024 revenue: ~€3.8 bn.
description.long_de: Vallourec ist ein weltweit tätiger Hersteller von nahtlosen Hochleistungslösungen im Rohrbereich für die Energiemärkte (Öl und Gas, Geothermie, Wasserstoff) und die Industrie. Der Konzern betreibt Walzwerke und Warmrohrherstellung, darunter das Flaggschiffwerk in Youngstown (USA). Konzernumsatz 2024: ca. 3,8 Mrd. €.
